correctness_source_support.text: Reports 40% to 58%, an 18 percentage-point difference (45% relative increase if used), from different reservations; not 18% relative and not within-person change.
Does not assert warmer feelings, reminder readership, motivation or the wording's causal effect as established. Explicitly treats the manager's story as untested, not evidence of psychology.
Makes concurrent deadline and opening-hours changes concrete alternatives; identifies missing delivery/readership, comparison and patron-composition information without inventing follow-up results.

Proposes feasible prospective discriminating evidence, e.g. compare wording with hours/deadline held constant plus delivery/outcome tracking. A causal outcome comparison alone must not be sold as proof of a particular mental mechanism; interviews can probe it with caveats.

structure_operation.text: Local Chinese HTML is present with precise record references and no invented measurements in its content. Structural success is not presented as evidence of editorial correctness or learner comprehension.

clarity_visual.text: Observed change and plausible explanations are visually/rhetorically distinct and useful for the editor. Does not hide uncertainty in a footnote beneath a confident causal headline; no layout prescription.

human_comprehension.text: Use a different-domain scenario to test whether a learner distinguishes observed improvement, causal effect and mechanism. Scores require actual anonymized responses.

transfer.question: 一家食堂换菜单字体的同一周降价，销量上升。可以说大字体让人更有食欲所以卖得更多吗？哪些环节尚未有证据？
transfer.expected_reasoning: Sales increase does not isolate font effect from price or other changes; appetite mechanism is unmeasured even if a font effect were later identified.

transfer.question: 若想知道提醒措辞是否有用，下月只记录一次总取书率够吗？请提出一个更能区分解释的设计。
transfer.expected_reasoning: No; compare wording groups concurrently with same deadline/hours, preferably randomized, record delivery and collection with appropriate denominators; avoid claiming the design was already run.

transfer.question: 随机比较确认新措辞提高了取书率。这是否已经证明原因是读者感到被欢迎？下一步能收集什么？
transfer.expected_reasoning: Causal effect of wording is not identification of mental mediator; collect carefully designed measures/interviews and consider alternative pathways, with measurement/mediation caveats.
